title: Witnessed tower functor from reduction comparisons and etale origins
statement: For schemes T and S and an adic coefficient datum d [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], let F_n be functors between the ambient finite-coefficient derived categories. Suppose natural isomorphisms rho identify reduction after F_(n+1) with F_n after reduction on the full reduction-domain subcategory [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility]. Suppose also that each F_n(P_n), for every witnessed bounded constructible input tower P, is supplied with an actual bounded-below etale origin and comparison isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. Then the family F satisfies PbcFamilyWitnessCompatibility.

proof.text: Conjugate the prescribed output theta, namely rho followed by F_n of input theta, by the two supplied origin isomorphisms and the canonical comparison-reduction isomorphism. Exact faithful comparison reflects a lower bound of the etale source. Bounded-below full faithfulness lifts this conjugate and its inverse uniquely to output beta, with its required image equation.

For a tower map use F_n on its level maps. Naturality of rho gives theta compatibility. Lift alpha_P followed by this map followed by alpha_Q inverse through bounded-below full faithfulness for the etale map. After applying faithful comparison, naturality of comparison-reduction and the two origin compatibility equations prove beta compatibility. Faithfulness and invertibility of alpha show maps are determined by their finite-level components, so the functor identity and composition laws follow. The demanded level and normalization equations hold by construction.

lean.statement:
theorem pbcFamilyWitnessCompatibility_of_origins
    {T S : Scheme.{u}} (d : Scheme.AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (F : ∀ n : ℕ, PbcWitnessAmbient T d n ⥤ PbcWitnessAmbient S d n)
    (rho : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (pbcWitnessReductionDomain T d n).ι ⋙ F (n + 1) ⋙ pbcWitnessReduction S d n ≅
        (pbcWitnessReductionDomain T d n).ι ⋙ pbcWitnessReduction T d n ⋙ F n)
    (L : ∀ (_P : PbcWitnessedInputTowers T d) (n : ℕ),
      DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (PbcQuotient d n))))
    (e : ∀ (_P : PbcWitnessedInputTowers T d) (n : ℕ),
      (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (PbcQuotient d n)) S).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (L _P n).obj ≅ (F n).obj (_P.obj.K n)) :
    PbcFamilyWitnessCompatibility T S d F
